title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. I see you have another offer, so I looked at the numbers again and can drop to €32.00 if we take the 35 days lead time. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. We have free capacity for your parts. 

Our Angebot is a price of €32.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our Lieferzeit is 28 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium. 

Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 35 days: a price of €32.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. 

Let's agree on this so we can start making chips.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Pump shaft HX (part:320070) - cost development and revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

Thank you for your improved offer and for your flexibility on lead time. Input costs for this part have eased since your costing was prepared.

The 1.4404 stainless index fell from 3182.67 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.80 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.
PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%.
PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

The attached packages cover 4200 pc per year over 24 months with a 35-day lead time. They include an option with 30-day payment, as you indicated faster payment is welcome. Is there a cheaper material or process variant you would suggest?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Pump shaft HX (part:320070) - cost development and revised packages
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. Your index numbers are spot on, so I sharpened my pencil and can drop the price to €29.00.

So, our offer is a price of €29.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.10 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.82 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.51 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Pump shaft HX (part:320070) - revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

Thank you for the further move and for listing the variant savings. We will review the material and tolerance options with engineering separately.

Your other main input cost driver has also eased: PPI-D351 fell from 137.0 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08) to 131.9 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-08), a change of -3.72%.

Your 2026Q3 scorecard (sc:70210@2026Q3) records 1863 ppm, above the 1200 ppm in your standard terms, which adds handling cost on our side.

The attached packages cover 4200 pc per year over 24 months with a 35-day lead time. They include 14-day and 30-day payment options, since you welcome faster payment. Could you make one of them your standing offer?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Pump shaft HX (part:320070) - revised packages
messages.body:
Hallo,

We did not know that - a fair point. You got me on the ppm numbers, fair point. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. We have already taken that index change data into account. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. With the 14 days payment you offered, I can do €28.00. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our Angebot is a price of €28.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Let's agree on this and get back to making chips.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

Jana Procházková
